title: ARSIA Broker Entry
description: One entry in the response from the broker discovery endpoint (GET /.well-known/arsia/brokers?residency={zone}). Describes a single eligible Compliance Broker for a given data residency zone. The full response is a JSON array of BrokerEntry objects. Defined in ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

agent_id.description: The broker's agent identifier (ARSIA-Core.md §3). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

inbox.description: Absolute URL of the broker's inbox endpoint. Senders POST ARSIA envelopes to this URL when routing through the broker. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

allOf.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the broker's physical location. For EU zone routing, this MUST be an EU/EEA member state (per broker relay Rule 2, ARSIA-Routing.md §7.3). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

residency_zones.description: Array of zone codes this broker serves (e.g. ['EU'], ['PT', 'EU']). Each code is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or a supranational identifier such as 'EU'. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

capacity.description: Capacity information for load-based broker selection. OPTIONAL. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum relay capacity per minute. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2 'capacity.requests_per_minute'.

current_load_pct.description: Current load as a percentage (0-100). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2 'capacity.current_load_pct'.

health.description: Broker health status reported by the most recent health check. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.

last_health_check.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with UTC designator and optional fractional seconds (up to microsecond precision). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.2.
